name: Shap-E (Text to 3D)
description: OpenAI's open-source text-to-3D and image-to-3D model. Generates 3D shapes from text prompts or images using implicit neural representations. Runs fully locally on your GPU.
author: OpenAI (extension by Modly)

params_schema.label: Guidance scale
params_schema.tooltip: Higher = prompt more strictly followed. 15 is a good default.

params_schema.label: Diffusion steps
params_schema.tooltip: More steps = better quality but slower. 64 is balanced.

params_schema.label: Render size
params_schema.tooltip: Resolution used internally for the NeRF rendering pass.
